evidence_required: FT-011-AC-004 RED: no active developer can select/create/inspect a Calibration run and no separately confirmed stored recommendation can cross the serving-control command, while direct viewing must not mutate settings; GREEN: the bounded no-store HTML flow authorizes only current developers, creates only validated immutable selections, displays stored run/results/drill-down, and a CSRF-protected confirmed apply resolves one stored recommendation then atomically updates the existing settings row/revision/calibration_id through serving_control while every view, create, rejection and unconfirmed action preserves serving state; decisive comparison: role/CSRF/form/failure fixtures plus before/after settings inspect denied, view/create, invalid/stale/unconfirmed and successful apply paths; artifact: .tasks/TASK-104-T3-FT-011-W3/pytest.txt, .tasks/TASK-104-T3-FT-011-W3/playwright-transcript.txt and .tasks/TASK-104-T3-FT-011-W3/calibration-applied.png.
purpose: Expose the smallest developer-only same-origin Calibration workflow and its one explicit manual serving-setting action.
success_outcome: An active developer can create and inspect reproducible runs, then only a separately confirmed stored recommendation can update the existing serving settings with Calibration provenance.
anti_goals: Do not add a JSON API, SPA framework, generic form/action framework, settings history/audit table or automatic apply.
Do not allow browser-supplied scores, thresholds, quality values, annotations, media paths or result bundles.
Do not implement promotion/deletion or ordinary retention in this task, and do not change pipeline revision selection.

forbidden_scope: Production staff accounts, settings, Calibration runs, Photos, Attempts and real participant data
Automatic apply, direct diagnostics writes to serving_control rows, pipeline-revision switch bypass and new audit/history persistence
Promotion/delete actions, ordinary retention and unrelated staff/participant routes
stop_conditions: The flow cannot remain the four accepted same-origin routes with existing staff session/CSRF primitives.
Manual apply cannot resolve a complete run's stored recommendation and call serving_control without diagnostics directly writing owner state.
T3 role/mutation probes cannot use disposable principals/settings/runs, safe rerun, redacted artifacts and full cleanup.

constraints: Diagnostics owns selection, authorization and recommendation resolution; HTTP and backend registration remain adapters, and only serving_control validates/writes settings.
Expose only GET/POST /staff/calibrations and GET/POST /staff/calibrations/{calibration_id}; use existing developer session, CSRF pair, no-store and sanitized 401/403/404/409/422/500 behavior.
Accept only stored selection/recommendation keys and matching confirmation; successful apply increments settings_revision, updates updated_at and records calibration_id in the existing row.
Use disposable current/revoked/wrong-role principals and isolated settings/runs with safe rerun, redacted artifacts and complete cleanup.

Use the installed playwright cli for one real-browser smoke in which an active developer creates a disposable run, inspects its completed detail and confirms one stored apply; browser-free HTTP/DOM probes are not substitutes.
invariants: Creating, viewing or rejecting a Calibration action never changes serving settings or pipeline revision.
Diagnostics never writes serving_control state directly and the browser cannot replace stored evidence or recommendation values.
No secrets, tokens, protected payloads or arbitrary form bodies enter URLs, logs, server events or retained task evidence.
verification_targets: Application fixtures prove exact bounded routes, redirects/no-store, escaped output, current-developer authorization, CSRF, validation and sanitized rollback mappings.

Before/after owner-state fixtures prove view/create/unconfirmed/rejected paths preserve settings and only one confirmed stored recommendation succeeds through serving_control with revision and calibration_id provenance.

playwright cli creates one disposable run, inspects separate results/drill-down and confirms one stored apply; retain the redacted transcript and post-apply screenshot at .tasks/TASK-104-T3-FT-011-W3/playwright-transcript.txt and .tasks/TASK-104-T3-FT-011-W3/calibration-applied.png; source inspection proves no generic API/framework, direct foreign write or automatic path.
